summary: Bounded WhatsApp stale session-lock recovery through the existing Health Manager.
root_cause: The WhatsApp credential lock referenced dead PID 4268 from 2026-10-06, so OpenClaw's existing channel monitor repeatedly restarted into file_lock_timeout.
architecture: No new daemon or scheduler. Health Manager validates PID plus process starttime, quarantines only an old orphaned lock, and asks the existing gateway owner for one restart.
restart_policy: Gateway restart is one-shot, detached from Health Manager, bounded by timeout --kill-after=5 30, and success is determined from live channel health rather than waiting for the CLI process to exit.
human_boundary: terminal_auth_logout remains human_required and is never auto-relinked.
